strings.list2.title: بازار، تفریح گاہیں اور زرعی فارم
strings.list2.lead: تاریخی سوق القیصریہ سے لے کر نخلستان کے باغوں اور فارموں تک: خریداری کریں، چہل قدمی کریں اور الاحساء کی نعمتوں کا ذائقہ چکھیں۔

changes.after: الاحساء کی نعمتوں کا ذائقہ چکھیں۔
changes.why: «چکھنا» takes a food, or «ذائقہ» / «مزہ», as its object; an abstract «نعمتیں» as its direct object is the English 'taste the bounty' carried over word for word. «… کا ذائقہ چکھیں» is the ordinary collocation, keeps the source's verb 'taste' (AR «ذُق»), and avoids «مزہ چکھنا» (which idiomatically means suffering the consequences — stage 1's own caution). Nothing enters: «ذائقہ» is the sense of the verb the source already uses; «نعمتیں» ('bounty', AR «خيرات») stays. Cost: two words longer (the string is also the meta description). Stage 1's form «الاحساء کی نعمتیں چکھیں» stays on record as the shorter alternative.

notes.text: Kept verbatim: the approved tm.json pair of nav.leisure (same English). No reason of native register to move it: «بازار، تفریح گاہیں اور زرعی فارم» is a plain Urdu list, the series comma before «اور» is not written, and «زرعی فارم» is N5's qualified form for the word standing alone in a heading. It does not contradict the crumb «بازار اور تفریح گاہیں» (crumb.leisure), which is a shortening of the same words, nor the header label (identical). Unchanged.
Kept verbatim: the approved tm.json pair of list.eyebrow (same English, the sister index's eyebrow). «سیاحتی رہنما» is the line's word for 'guide' («گائیڈ» is a barred loan, role file 02). Unchanged.

Read for officialese, calqued order and filler: none. The frame «… سے لے کر … تک:» is the approved sister list.lead's, the three honorific imperatives in a row («خریداری کریں، چہل قدمی کریں اور … چکھیں») are natural and parallel, and the colon for the source's em dash is the sister's. «تاریخی» for 'storied' (AR «العريقة») is evaluative, not a superlative (P19), and is the press's own epithet for this market. «فارموں» stays bare: in running text, beside «باغوں» and governed by «نخلستان کے», it does not stand alone as N5's label case does; stage 1's alternative «زرعی فارموں» stays on record for stage 4 / the blind reader. Names untouched: «سوق القیصریہ» bare, byte for byte its key (P3c-labels: the string is also the meta description; the plain generic «بازار» stands in the neighbouring line, the h1 and snippet title); «الاحساء» head form, Urdu possessive (P8, N115).

Not touched, for stage 4 as stage 1 asked: ruling N47 and the bare «نخلستان» when the string is read alone as a search snippet. An editorial reading does not settle it: inside the sentence the oasis is tied to Al-Ahsa by the close («الاحساء کی نعمتوں»), and N47 itself says it is no rule about a summary read on its own. Stage 1's alternative (naming the oasis, 'Al-Ahsa' at the close becoming 'here') stays on record; if it is taken, the close becomes «یہاں کی نعمتوں کا ذائقہ چکھیں».
